title: Sr. React Native (iOS Swift and Objective C)
description:
**An introduction to Codal**Codal is an award\-winning web design and development consultancy that helps enterprise organizations solve complex problems and accelerate growth through elegant, data\-driven digital solutions. Our areas of expertise include application modernization, eCommerce, UX/UI design, product strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. At Codal, you’ll collaborate with some of the most innovative organizations in the world and work on cutting\-edge technologies that push the boundaries of design and software development. You’ll also be part of a community that promotes long\-term success, not just for our clients, but for each other. We’ll help you develop a professional roadmap that takes your career to new heights. **Who you’ll be working with**We build the solutions dreamed up by the product and design teams. Our goal is to deliver working software every two weeks. We are a large team that spans across three global offices, but we collaborate and integrate front\- and back\-end components and interfaces to provide a user\-centered experience through web and mobile platforms.**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality cross\-platform mobile applications using **React Native**.
* Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable application components using **TypeScript** and modern JavaScript.
* Develop and integrate native functionality using **Swift/SwiftUI** for iOS and **Kotlin** for Android.
* Build and maintain **Turbo Modules** and native bridges to expose platform\-specific functionality to React Native.
* Work with **Expo**, including development, builds, and Over\-the\-Air (OTA) updates where applicable.
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Optimize application performance, memory usage, startup time, and overall user experience across iOS and Android.
* Investigate, debug, and resolve production issues using monitoring and profiling tools.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and estimation sessions.
* Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers by promoting engineering best practices.
* Integrate third\-party SDKs and platform services such as payments, analytics, authentication, push notifications, and maps.
* Publish and maintain applications on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, including release management, code signing, provisioning profiles, and app submissions.
* Stay updated with the latest React Native ecosystem, mobile technologies, and industry best practices.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful (Requirements)**  
**Must Have Skills**

* Strong experience building production applications using **React Native**.
* Proficiency in **TypeScript** and modern **JavaScript (ES6\+)**.
* Experience with state management libraries such as **Redux Toolkit**, **Redux Saga**, or **Context API**.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and handling asynchronous programming.
* Hands\-on experience with **iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Android development using Kotlin**.
* Experience building and integrating **native modules** using **Turbo Modules** and native bridging.
* Experience with **Expo**, including development, builds, and OTA updates.
* Strong understanding of the **React Native New Architecture**, including **Turbo Modules**, **JSI**, and **Fabric**.
* Experience deploying and maintaining applications on the **Apple App Store** and **Google Play Store**.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills for React Native applications.
* Experience using **Git**, pull request workflows, and code review practices.

**Should Have Skills**

* Strong understanding of React Hooks, component lifecycle, and functional component patterns.
* Experience integrating third\-party SDKs including analytics, authentication, payment gateways, maps, or push notifications.
* Knowledge of application performance optimization techniques including FlatList optimization, memoization, lazy loading, and reducing unnecessary re\-renders.
* Experience debugging production issues using tools such as **Flipper**, **React Native DevTools**, **Xcode Instruments**, and **Android Studio Profiler**.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, reusable component design, and clean coding practices.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Experience mentoring developers and participating in technical discussions and code reviews.

**Nice to Have Skills**

* Experience with CI/CD tools such as **GitHub Actions**, **Bitrise**, **Fastlane**, or **CircleCI**.
* Experience with **Firebase** services including Crashlytics, Analytics, Cloud Messaging, and Remote Config.
* Experience using application monitoring and observability tools such as **New Relic** or **Sentry**.
* Experience with **Chat Messaging and Audio/Video calling apps.**
* Knowledge of mobile application security, including secure storage, SSL pinning, and authentication best practices.
* Experience writing unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests using **Jest**, **React Native Testing Library**, or **Detox**.
* Experience working with **Firebase**, **Expo** or other third party tools.
* Familiarity with accessibility (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n).

**Need another reason to hit the “apply” button?**

* Codal is a global agency with over 250 employees, and offices in the US, UK, Canada and India
* We are a BigCommerce Partner and have won the Partner of the year award twice (most recently this past year).
* We regularly host happy hours, dinners, excursions, and other company events to unwind after a hard day at work.
* Company sponsored lunch every Wednesday.
* Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical coverage for employees and their dependents
* Maternity/Paternity Leave: Additional time off and support for new parents
* Professional Development: Opportunities for training, workshops, conferences to enhance employees' skills and knowledge
* Accidental Insurance

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Ahmedabad, Gujarat: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Do you hold experience with iOS Swift and Objective C

Experience:

* Swift: 3 years (Preferred)
